contents.currentItem: Get support if you're going to court as a witness
section.heading: Get support giving evidence as a witness
section.intro: If you're going to court to give evidence, the charity Victim Support can help you prepare, and support you during the court process.
whatTheyCanDo.heading: What they can do to help you
whatTheyCanDo.intro: Victim Support will put you in touch with a trained volunteer. They can give you practical information about the court process, for example:
whatTheyCanDo.practicalItems: show you the courtroom before the trial
help you with claiming expenses you might be entitled to
refer you to other organisations that could support you
whatTheyCanDo.emotionalIntro: They can also give you emotional support, for example:
whatTheyCanDo.emotionalItems: help you feel more confident when giving evidence
be there to talk to in confidence
come to court with you when you give your evidence
be with you on the day of the trial
help you with any extra support needs at home
whatTheyCanDo.impartial: The volunteers remain impartial to the court case – they do not take sides.
findOutMore.heading: Find out more or refer yourself to the service
findOutMore.linkText: Contact the Witness Service (opens in new tab).
